mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assets (asset_name, status, purchase_cost, purchase_date, category_id, vendor_id, is_active) VALUES (#{assetName}, #{status}, #{purchaseCost}, #{purchaseDate}, #{categoryId}, #{vendorId}, #{isActive})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assets WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = true
SELECT * FROM assets WHERE is_active = true
mapper.update: UPDATE assets SET asset_name = #{assetName}, status = #{status}, purchase_cost = #{purchaseCost}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, category_id = #{categoryId}, vendor_id = #{vendorId}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE assets SET is_active = false WHERE id = #{id}
